comment: nexus-wbfpw.76. One shape table read by TWO tests that each exercise a real implementation: the engine's empty-tenant probe (ReaperRepository.holdsNothing, behind Rdr192BackfillGate; Rdr192EmptyTenantParityIntegrationTest) and the client rung's census (rdr192_manifest_backfill._default_census plus _cross_check_empty_listing; tests/upgrade/test_rdr192_empty_tenant_parity.py). The probe cannot be reached per tenant from Python (reaper.last_pass.tenants_empty is a machine-wide count over every tenant a pass visits), so the two sides are pinned to this table instead. The invariant is engine_empty implies client_census_clean: the engine may read stricter, never looser. A shape that changes either verdict fails the side that moved, and the Python test also checks the invariant over the table itself and that the census actually read what the collections spec seeded. The engine probe reads only nexus.chunks, so the documents column matters only on the client side. Client side, list_collections is driven by collection_vector_stats: registered-collection-no-chunks reaches the client as an empty listing, the same as empty, and takes the _cross_check_empty_listing branch (zero collections read). legacy-unmanifested-note is a live catalog document with physical_collection set, no file_path and no manifest row, whose chunk metadata carries its catalog_doc_id: the engine still sees a chunk (not empty) and the client census counts it legacy-unmanifested (not clean).
